limitations: Source scanner is lexical, not an AST/cfg evaluator.
Runtime identity is exact retained Cargo/libtest evidence, not current execution.
Function-name matches are candidates, not proof of module registration.
No coverage percentages, assertion value or semantic equivalence inferred from counts.
Macro-generated/parameterized tests may have no lexical function match.
Non-Rust script tests are inventoried by CI design, not represented as Rust tests.
